page.overview:
What is Mirogana Breakdown Care?

Mirogana Breakdown Care was a speeder business that operated on the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara. an individual on Toshara crashes their speeder in the Kashudà Pit in the Southern Falls region of the moon. The Breaddown care service informed the customer that the service could pick them up but was unable to retrieve the speeder from the pit. However the service did offer to supply the customer with a replacement vehicle and driving lessons if they upgraded to the premium service plan.

In 3 ABY the scoundrel Kay Vess found a datapad in the capital city Mirogana with the message regarding the speeder crash in the Kashùda Pit. Vess also retrieved the valuables from a container next to the speeder wreck in the pit.

Mirogana Breakdown Care was mentioned in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws published by Ubisoft. It is part of an optional intel quest and the items can be retrieved from the pit before reading the datapad.
